coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the 10 ground-truth variable fields as evaluation items, 2 match (20%): the SSP-on versus SSP-off manipulation and string/lexicon-based ASR measurement, which appears in the sensitivity analysis.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes HarmBench/JailbreakBench for AdvBench/MaliciousInstruct, omits JailTrickBench, replaces the five-model comparison with Llama-3.1-8B, and uses GCG/BEA/templates instead of AutoDAN/PAIR. It omits the 10–100-token suffix range and fixed PAIR query budget, replaces the GPT evaluator with Llama-Guard, and reports median/IQR across seeds rather than mean ASR over 3–5 runs.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that safety system prompts substantially reduce ASR or reports the model-specific AutoDAN and PAIR reductions. Hypotheses in the design are not observed conclusions.
